Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. - Competitors can bring 1 guest for free to the competition! If they would like to bring a 2nd a more guests, we are charging $5 per extra guest via paypal at the front desk. - **Spectators not accociated with the competition may still pay the $5 spectator fee to attend and watch the competition up close and personal!**

items.name: Missouri Summer Kickoff 2024

venue.name: Glendalough Convention Center
venue.details: Enter through the main doors on the Northside of the building.

items.information: **Note: This competition is on a *Sunday*** We have a local facebook group where we will be posting upcoming events as they are announced as well as supporting local cubing conversations for Missouri. Jump over and join the [Missouri Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1548283828980986/) facebook group. Please note that this schedule is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. Please view the other tabs to get more information. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, ***all competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, you may want to look at CubingUSA's Competitor Tutorial.***

items.information: * **Participants have to bring their own cube for the event. Check out all the other Tabs for more detailed information.** * **Make sure to be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. Late entries won't be allowed to participate.** * **Attend the tutorial session if you're new to WCA competitions or unfamiliar with its rules.** * **Bring a government ID card for verification if it's your first time participating in a WCA competition.** * **Participants are expected to volunteer and will be assigned with roles as judges, scramblers, or runners, with the exception of newcomers.**

items.name: Pitt Meadows Spring Open 2024

venue.name: [Pitt Meadows Secondary School](https://secondary.sd42.ca/pmss/)
venue.address: 19438 116b Ave, Pitt Meadows, BC V3Y 1H2, Canada
venue.details: The venue will be held in the main gym, please enter through the gym doors (east side)

items.information: **Please review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You only need to show up for the events that you're competing in - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, so please be ready for each event/round **about 30 minutes in advance**, just in case. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time. **Notice of filming and photography**: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. Masks will be optional. Do not attend if you feel/are sick.
